title: Choosing the Right Drill for Your Project
author: editor@example.com
summary: Corded or cordless, and how much torque you actually need.
content:
Corded drills win on sustained torque and never need charging mid-job. Cordless wins on reach — no cable to fight on a ladder or in a crawl space.

For most home projects, an 18V cordless drill with two batteries covers both cases well enough that the corded advantage rarely matters.
seo_description: A buying guide comparing corded and cordless drills for home projects.
